title: 2 homegrown technologies advance toward wider use in South Luzon

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Two locally developed technologies for weather monitoring and waste management are moving closer to wider commercial and institutional use following agreements signed during a regional innovation summit on Oct. 8. The Department of Science and Technology (DOST) in Mimaropa said the agreements, signed during the 2026 South Luzon Innovation and Technology Transfer Summit (SLITTS), covered the commercialization of Project MOSES, an Internet of Things (IoT) based weather monitoring system, and the adoption of Rezbin, a smart waste management technology.
